program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((regions
           (map
             (lambda (p)
               (connected-region
                 g
                 (fst p)
                 (snd p)
                 (lambda (rr cc v) (not (= v 0)))
                 4))
             (filter
               (lambda (p) (not (= (cell-at g (fst p) (snd p)) 0)))
               (grid-positions g))))
         (largest
           (if (empty? regions)
               (list)
               (first (sort regions (lambda (a b) (> (length a) (length b))))))))
    (if (empty? largest)
        (list)
        (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells largest)))
          (crop g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
